description: This file defines two PyTorch neural network modules, 'Fold' and 'Unfold', which perform tensor operations related to sliding window extraction and reconstruction, commonly used in convolutional neural networks for image processing.

classes.name: Fold
classes.description: A module that combines sliding local blocks into a large tensor, effectively performing the inverse of 'Unfold'.

classes.name: Unfold
classes.description: A module that extracts sliding local blocks from a batched input tensor, used for operations like im2col.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the forward pass of the module, applying the respective tensor operation.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string with the module's configuration parameters for representation.
